title: Building Macroeconomically Relevant Climate Indices via the Assemblage VAR (Barrette, Goulet Coulombe, Reinicke, draft 09-22-26)
data_sources: Actuaries Climate Index U.S. portion (ACI 1961-1990 normals, components T90,T10,Rx5Day,CDD,WP90,sea level)
NOAA weather and atmospheric panel (Temperature, Precipitation, Heating/C Cooling Degree Days, PDSI, PHDI, PMDI, Palmer Z-Index across ten zones + Mauna Loa CO2)
FRED-MD macro series INDPRO, PCEPI, UNRATE, EXUSUKx, HOUST + Wu-Xia SHADOWRATE
sample: U.S. climate-macro VAR. Constituent panel X_t: (i) ACI U.S. portion six standardized components T90,T10,Rx5Day,CDD,WP90,sea level; paper excludes CDD (annual interpolated), uses remaining 5. Benchmark x_t = equal-weight (20% each) analogue of ACI but constructed from transformed components. Three specifications of increasing granularity: National d=5 (5 national ACI components), Regional d=34 (5 components x 7 regions, Midwest no sea level), NOAA d=82 (Temperature, Precipitation, Heating/C Cooling Degree Days, four Palmer drought indices across 10 zones + Mauna Loa CO2). Transformation for SVAR: month-on-month changes of each component X_{j,t} standardized using 1961-1990 moments (WMO normals); this preserves ACI normalization logic but aligns to stationary analysis; five-year smoothing not used. VAR state y_t(w) = (x*_t(w), y_t^{-x}) in R^k, k=7 : climate index first, INDPRO, PCEPI, UNRATE, SHADOWRATE (Wu Xia 2016), EXUSUKx, HOUST. All series FRED-MD except shadow rate. Filters: lag p=12; sample 1975:M1 to 2025:M4, COVID window 2020:M1-2021:M6 excluded (held fixed at Dec-2019 value in expanding windows); VAR estimated on n=T-p effective observations. Effective n not printed as number -> not stated. Missing data: CDD excluded explicitly; Midwest sea level missing by construction. Cross-sectional aggregation for display only partitions 82 NOAA raw series into region x variable cells (Table A: 5 named climate regions + Rest; 4 named variable families + Others) summing raw-series weights; underlying index remains w'X_t with 82 unaggregated series.
method: 1. Build transformed constituents X_t: for each ACI/NOAA raw component compute month-on-month change and standardize by 1961-1990 mean/SD (actuarial normalization). Exclude CDD (annual interpolated). Benchmark x_t = equal-weight average of transformed constituents for comparison (20% each when d=5).

2. Define assembled variable x*_t(w)=w'X_t (component-space) or w'O_t (rank-space) where O_t=sort(X_t) order statistics. Simplex constraint w>=0, 1'w=1. VAR state y_t(w)=(x*_t(w), INDPRO log-diff, PCEPI log-diff, UNRATE first-diff, SHADOWRATE level, EXUSUKx log-diff, HOUST log-diff) in Cholesky order climate first.

3. For fixed w estimate reduced-form VAR(p) with p=12, intercept nu, matrices A_j, covariance Sigma: Y(w)=Z(w)B(w)+U(w) with Y n x k, Z n x (k*p+1), n=T-p. OLS equation-by-equation equals Gaussian quasi-MLE max l_T(B,Sigma;w).

4. Compute sample learning criterion S_T(w)=hat l_{1,T}(w)-hat l_{0,T}(w) where hat l_1 is maximized VAR log-likelihood at B-hat_T(w), Sigma-hat_{1,T}(w)=n^{-1}U-hat'U-hat, hat l_0 is maximized mean-only benchmark y_t(w)=mu(w)+u0_t(w) likelihood at mu-hat, Sigma-hat_0. Population target S(w)=l1*(w)-l0*(w)=0.5 log(|Sigma0*(w)|/|Sigma1*(w)|). Penalized estimator w-hat(lambda)=argmin_{w in simplex} -S_T(w)+lambda*pen(w).

5. Component-space penalty pen=||w - w^{ref}||_2^2 ridge to equal-weight reference. Rank-space pen=||D w||_2^2 fused ridge smoothing across adjacent ranks (D first-difference). Rank-space mean anchoring n^{-1} sum w'O_t = n^{-1} sum x_t redundant because constituents zero-mean and 1'w=1 fixes scale. Non-negativity keeps index as level not dispersion.
6. Optimize via Sequential Quadratic Programming (R NlcOptim solnl) with lower bounds for w>=0, linear equality 1'w=1 (and mean target where binding). Warm start at benchmark equal weights.

7. Select regularization lambda via non-overlapping block cross-validation with 5 contiguous blocks: for each fold m hold out one block, estimate w-hat^{(-m)}(lambda) on remaining 4 blocks, compute fold held-out criterion S_{T_m}^{(m)}(w-hat^{(-m)}) using VAR estimated on held-out block alone, maximize average held-out criterion over grid -> lambda-hat. This lambda-hat held fixed thereafter (fixed-tuning convention). Reported estimate w-hat(lambda-hat) interpreted relative to penalized population target w*(eta) with eta=lambda/n. Paper does not assume penalty vanishes.

8. Construct final index x*_t = x*_t(w-hat(lambda-hat)), estimate VAR on {y_t(w-hat)} . Structural shocks identified recursively (Cholesky) with assembled climate ordered first. Report cumulative IRFs to one-SD innovation in each specification's own climate measure (not common shock), except SHADOWRATE in levels. Comparison is across alternative measures.

9. Inference main text: 68% pointwise equal-tailed percentile-t intervals from fixed-weights residual bootstrap (Kunsch 1989, Hall 1992, Brueggemann et al 2016). Conditional on lambda-hat and w-hat: center residuals, resample overlapping blocks length l=floor(n^{1/3})=8 preserving contemporaneous cross-equation dependence, generate B_outer=1000 artificial series y*_t = nu-hat + sum A_j-hat y*_{t-j}+u*_t initialized at first p observed rows, refit VAR p=12, recompute IRFs. Interval [theta-hat - q(1-a/2) sigma-hat, theta-hat - q(a/2) sigma-hat] with a=0.32, q quantile of (theta*-b - theta-hat)/sigma*-b. sigma*-b from B_inner=100 draws per outer, sigma-hat from 200 draws. Companion eigenvalue >=1 redrawn up to 50 times else missing; none redrawn. seed 123.

10. Robustness: weight-reestimating pairs bootstrap holding lambda-hat fixed but re-estimating w and VAR jointly in each replication. Align current-outcome/lag-regressor pairs used for S_T, draw overlapping blocks length l=max{p+1, floor(T^{1/3})}=13 (floor p+1 binds), resample pair indices with replacement preserving lag structure. In each of B=1000 replications solve for w* under same simplex constraints starting at w-hat, re-estimate B*, Sigma*, IRFs via Cholesky ordered first cumulated as before. No optimization failures (all 1000 returned). Weight bands = pointwise percentile intervals (simplex support), index envelopes likewise, IRF bands = pointwise 68% basic (reverse-percentile) [2 theta-hat - q*0.84, 2 theta-hat - q*0.16] not studentized.

11. Expanding-window stability: re-estimate w on expanding window vintage 2005-2025, COVID window held fixed at Dec-2019, plot composition by variable families (component-space) or rank quintiles (rank-space) smoothed over 1 year.

12. Rank-to-named mapping: effective loading omega_{m,t}=w-hat_{pi_t^{-1}(m)} where pi_t links rank slots to names; average loading omega-bar_m = T^{-1} sum omega_{m,t}; rank occupancy p_{mr}=fraction periods component m occupies rank r; size-neutral usage U_m = omega-bar_m/(1/d)-1 = d sum_r w-hat_r p_{mr} -1 (% deviation from equal weight). Family average pooled for NOAA.

13. Display aggregation: NOAA 82 raw series only for figure summed within consolidated region (5 named regions: Upper Midwest, Ohio Valley, Northwest, Northern Rockies & Plains, Northeast; Rest= contigu. US aggregate + South/West/Southeast/Southwest + world CO2) x variable (Temp, Precip, Heat.DD, Palmer.Z, Others) cells; not used in estimation.
